title: Synergistic effects of liquid phase exfoliated molybdenum based 2D nanosheets and MWCNTs for high performance supercapacitors
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00964A, Paper
Riya Malik, Ankur Rana, Megha Rana, Dilip K. Singh, R. Srivastava, C. K. Suman
This work investigates the application of liquid phase exfoliated Mo-based transition metal dichalcogenide (TMDC) 2D-nanosheets integrated with multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) as electrode material for high-performance supercapacitors.
